parameters.query:
-- Save the partner's Decision, Reason and Outcome from the Excel file. Keyed by the TED notice ID.
-- Changing a decision in Excel updates it; an unchanged row leaves the decision date as it was.
WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS t(source_id text, decision text, reason text, outcome text)
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_id) id, source_id, recommendation
  FROM tenders WHERE source = 'ted'
  ORDER BY source_id, first_seen_at DESC, id DESC
)
INSERT INTO decisions (tender_id, decision, reason, recommendation, decided_by, outcome)
-- A notice amended after the decision gets a new row in tenders: the decision stays on the row it was saved on.
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT d.tender_id FROM decisions d JOIN tenders t ON t.id = d.tender_id
                 WHERE t.source = 'ted' AND t.source_id = i.source_id LIMIT 1), l.id), i.decision, COALESCE(NULLIF(i.reason, ''), '(no reason given)'), l.recommendation, 'partner (Excel)', i.outcome
FROM input i JOIN latest l USING (source_id)
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT one_decision_per_tender DO UPDATE
SET decision   = EXCLUDED.decision,
    reason     = EXCLUDED.reason,
    outcome    = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.outcome, decisions.outcome),   -- a cleared Outcome cell keeps the saved one
    recommendation = COALESCE(decisions.recommendation, EXCLUDED.recommendation),
    decided_at = CASE WHEN decisions.decision IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.decision
                        OR decisions.reason   IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.reason
                      THEN now() ELSE decisions.decided_at END
RETURNING tender_id;

-- The tender list for the Excel file: the latest version of each notice. Open ones first: GO, CONDITIONAL, CHECK YOURSELF,
-- not assessed yet, then NO-GO at the bottom; within each, nearest deadline first.
-- Tenders due today or earlier drop out. Closed tenders stay only if the partner said go, so the outcome can be filled in after the award.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_id) *
  FROM tenders WHERE source = 'ted'
  ORDER BY source_id, first_seen_at DESC, id DESC
), dec AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.source_id) t.source_id, d.decision, d.reason, d.outcome
  FROM decisions d JOIN tenders t ON t.id = d.tender_id
  ORDER BY t.source_id, d.decided_at DESC
)
SELECT l.source_id, l.title, l.buyer, l.country, l.deadline, l.url, l.recommendation, l.explanation, l.open_questions, l.status,
       l.first_seen_at,
       l.raw->>'notice-type' AS notice_type,
       l.raw->'deadline-receipt-request-date-lot' AS request_deadlines,
       dec.decision, dec.reason, dec.outcome,
       (SELECT json_agg(r ORDER BY r.id) FROM (SELECT id, name, typology, country, year, size_m2, budget_eur_m FROM reference_projects) r) AS refs
FROM latest l LEFT JOIN dec USING (source_id)
WHERE l.deadline IS NULL OR l.deadline::date > current_date OR dec.decision = 'go'
ORDER BY (l.deadline IS NOT NULL AND l.deadline::date <= current_date),
         CASE l.recommendation WHEN 'go' THEN 0 WHEN 'conditional_go' THEN 1 WHEN 'unresolved' THEN 2 WHEN 'no_go' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END,
         l.deadline NULLS LAST, l.source_id;
